fields.title: Conclusion
fields.md:
1. One-sentence conclusion: The 2026-11-19 8-K is a record of the completed issuance of five series of yen notes (¥182.3 billion, weighted coupon 2.97%) that were finalized on 11-13, and it gives no new figures — the net increase of about $540 million and the annual interest increase of about $29 million (estimate) are too small to reach earnings or cash, and the 25/50/25 probabilities and the assumed value are unchanged (source: [8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526468549/d197844d8k.htm)).
2. Briefing in 5 lines
   - 8-K (2026-11-19): issuance of five series of yen senior notes completed — ¥92.0 billion 2.624% 2029 · ¥57.3 billion 3.007% 2031 · ¥16.1 billion 3.313% 2033 · ¥2.7 billion 3.661% 2036 · ¥14.2 billion 4.571% 2056 ([8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526468549/d197844d8k.htm)).
   - Terms are the same as the FWP (11-13) and 424B5 (11-17 EDGAR) — T8 stays confirmed; only settlement completion is added.
   - Net increase of ¥85.9 billion (about $540 million, yen/dollar 159.97, estimate) versus the ¥96.4 billion to be refinanced · annual interest increase of about ¥4.67 billion (formula).
   - Reading of Buffett's Thanksgiving press release (11-16) — the conversion and donation figures match 13D/A No. 82 ([press release](https://www.berkshirehathaway.com/news/nov1626.pdf)).
   - No rule R1–R6 met — scenarios 25/50/25 and assumed value band $265.0–$684.5 maintained · Class B 11/19 close $572.04 (P/B 1.60x) ([stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/brk.b/history/)).
3. Three data points to check directly before the next issue
   - Repayment of the ¥73.4 billion (0.955%, maturing 2026-11-27) to be refinanced — 4Q26 10-K debt note (T2, [424B5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465047/d86634d424b5.htm)).
   - Whether Bending Spoons' 6.4% stake as of 9/30 is the figure after settlement of the additional shares (T5, [13G](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526464218/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml)).
   - Whether Delta's stake crosses from 9.8% to 10% — 13G amendment · Form 4 (T3, [Delta 13G](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526464189/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml)).
